Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Add cross-platform compatibility enforcement and fix production mode

Features:
- Add custom ESLint plugin \(eslint-rules/cross-platform.js\) with rules:
  - no-hardcoded-path-separator: Flags .split\(''/''\) patterns
  - no-platform-specific-shell: Flags spawn\(''open''\), spawn\(''start''\), etc.
  - no-console-in-main: Flags console.log in main process code
  - no-hardcoded-app-paths: Flags /Users/, C:\\Users\\, etc.
  - require-platform-check: Warns on undocumented platform checks
- Add Husky pre-commit hook with lint-staged
- Add .gitattributes for line ending normalization

Fixes:
- Fix production mode routing \(BrowserRouter -> HashRouter\)
- Replace console.log/debug/error with Logger in main.ts
- Guard canvas:debugFetch API to only work in development
- Guard preload.ts startup log to only show in development
- Disable DEBUG_LAYOUT flags in Dashboard and Layout components
- Move drag handle to bottom-right of course cards

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
